mission: Jacen's reply; he runs the fork-vision technique once — he sees, in one future, Nelani alive and Luke dead at his hand, and in the other, Nelani dead and Luke alive.
why_now: Nelani has just finished her case.
opening_hook: Jacen across from Nelani, reaching interior for the fork-vision technique.
conflict: Jacen's two visible futures — Nelani alive and Luke dead vs. Nelani dead and Luke alive — as a direct ethical calculus.
turning_point: Jacen chooses the future in which Luke lives.
closing_hook: Jacen reaching for his lightsaber hilt; Nelani, reading his posture, doing the same.
sensory_details: Chamber's hush; fork-vision's subjective pressure; the saber hilts settling in each Jedi's hand.
emotional_trajectory: Received case → fork-vision run → chosen future.
action_beats: Chooses the future with Luke alive
